title: Transformer trait & one transformer per data_type

user_story.i_want: one transformer per data_type behind a common trait
user_story.so_that: adding a new data_type means adding a type, not editing a giant match everywhere

description:
Define a `Transformer` trait with an associated `Row` type: given a classified record, return a typed row or a TransformError. - `MetricTransformer`: value must be finite, kind gauge|counter, counters non-negative, default unit from the catalog, tags flattened to a string map.
- `EventTransformer`: properties must be an object; user_id/session_id are optional strings of at most 128 characters.
- `LogTransformer`: normalises level (WARNING to warn, ERR to error) and truncates the message at 32 KiB with a flag.
Dispatch from DataType to transformer with an enum match. Write ADR 0002 on why: associated types make `dyn Transformer` awkward, so it compares enum dispatch with trait objects.

acceptance_criteria.then: at least 8 cases pass, including NaN, negative counter, missing optional fields and unknown level
the error names the field and the record is quarantined as invalid_payload; the file continues
it lists exactly what to touch to add a 4th data_type

rust_concepts: Generics vs trait objects vs enum dispatch

references.title: The Rust Book ch.6: Enums & pattern matching
The Rust Book ch.11: Writing tests
